Both native comparisons are valid mixed B/EXPLORE. Do not rescue the adverse primary with the positive descriptive two-instance T-G mean or an improved local statistic. The outcome-informed secondary F-C differences are +0.0962618653/+0.1078445744 J, not new primary results.

The strongest stop case is that the allocated follow-up has now observed the F disadvantage again without repeating T's generic-gate advantage. More unchanged replication would add variation evidence, but no specific changed intervention yet follows from these results. The strongest continue case is that both learned correction packages beat C and the fixed retained-history/retrace combination improved more; two finite-budget fits do not exhaust legal selective policies or alternative optimization/representation choices. Nonzero gate opportunities, updates and movement were recorded. They rule out an absent-learner description, not establish successful optimization or explain the reversal. Weigh both cases. Absence of improvement may justify a specifically motivated B; do not reject it by a generic seed, significance or stronger-evidence threshold. Conversely, untested alternatives alone do not select a successor.

Keep the actual MARL path explicit: simultaneous movement/interference changes a UAV's private observation; it remembers one prior lowest-SINR user coordinate; unambiguous loss of own eligibility plus an away-pointing base proposal permits retracing its own realized prior displacement; the resulting joint geometry changes native team return. C always applies the sampled frozen proposal, F always retraces on this cue, T learns the structured private gate, and G contains T's full path plus a same-information residual. Each retains its own trajectory, private recurrence and actual-command feedback; gate-only PPO uses the collected proposal. F already uses retained history. Own-link loss can be beneficial handoff, not global service failure. Fixed roster and primitive-time team credit are the tested scope.

Distinguish the current learned-selection package from untested hypotheses about the one-anchor predicate, retrace versus dwell/geometry, history necessity and partner response. They are not automatically proposed objects, causal findings or justification for a search/diagnostic prelude. If you select a changed B, identify one concrete intervention, its legal information/action or credit path, real learner and competent comparator including F, primary native observable, smallest sufficient work and the decision its outcome changes. Explain why that candidate is more valuable than ending this package or the legal but unallocated unchanged B. Give actual source or literature support for a genuinely new mechanism claim, or label it as inference/hypothesis; do not present prior adjacent DACOM/CoDe grounding as UAV performance evidence. If no such candidate can be justified, make the smallest end decision. Do not provide a filler menu or an unlimited ladder.

There are two matched training instances, each with its own 32 paired joint-episode evaluation panel and conditional SEs. They are not 64 independent trained policies; panel changes and training randomness are not causally separated. The base DENSE/8201 was selected with old outcomes visible. Tuned same-information current-host headroom is absent, not a gate. Preserve inherited 0.25 episode-sum S = 0.0009765625 J and separate MEI 0.01 J = 2.56 S; neither is passed against F. No stable, causal, optimal-fixed-policy, whole-direction, Portfolio or formal UAV-validation conclusion is licensed. R02's legal history gain 0.022197511111... and positive action witness remain; R03's exact compatible-history upper 0.2139371014275... <1/4 and old-host closure remain. No old threshold/envelope tuning, R01 rescue or new recast is proposed; recasts 2, lowest sequencing and Root-owned ACTIVE/MEDIUM state persist.
